_about: Northstar v1 (7 Oct 2026), trained from Top-100 #2 (r14, symz.mov, podcast/motivational, score 9). A warm, tight podcast plate with stacked mixed-size captions (tiny lead words, ONE big cream bold word, an elegant serif word for the emotional beat, a handwriting phrase to close, diagonal word stairs on short asides), cut fast with cinematic stills (a starry sky, a lone figure at sunset, a dark dramatic scene) that keep the captions over them, and a light paper concept page where the key word cycles through typefaces over an engraving (brain, gears). Picture change about every second in the busiest stretches. Northstar 2 (hardened, 9 Oct 2026): names keep their capitals, captions stay >= 14% from the top and under the chin (close-ups shrink onto a blurred backdrop), 1.22x face-anchored punch-ins on the hero words, teal-lifted shadows under the warm grade, stills cut in sharp-from-blur (no double exposure).

director.style: Northstar: a warm cinematic podcast cut. Tight warm speaker, stacked captions with one cream bold word, cinematic stills that carry the captions, and one light paper concept page. Thoughtful, emotional, premium.
director.captions: captions.heroes: a content word for nearly every phrase (never filler). captions.serif: 1-3 emotional or contrast words (second, right, truth). captions.script: ONE closing phrase in handwriting. captions.stairs: one short aside of 3 words (e.g. 'so you know', 'super fast super quick') as a diagonal staircase. Lowercase. Proper nouns keep their capitals. captions.highlight: 3-4 hero words get a 1.22x punch-in (the reference's close-up push). Captions break at sentence ends; never end a caption on a weak word.
director.cutaways: 2-3 image scenes per 20 s on the big ideas: night sky, mountains, coast, a place the speaker names. PD/CC0 only (stock_fetch.py), no identifiable people, no readable text or logos. captions: true, in: focus (opaque, pulls sharp), out: cut, 1.0-1.6 s, grade saturate(0.9) contrast(1.15) brightness(0.8).
director.concept: ONE concept scene per reel: word = the spoken key word, engravings = ONE public-domain engraving that depicts THAT word (book for language, compass for north). Never a generated engraving with fake text (robot).
director.rhythm: cadence.targetPerMin 48 fills between scenes; scenes spread evenly, one every 3-4 s.
director.dont: No neon, no red, no hard flashes, no black word cards.
